name: HAT-P-3B

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list HAT-P-3 and HAT-P-3B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 1510191594552968832 and 1510191594552968960), 1,321 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 9.2e-6: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to HAT-P-3, 1,321 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 311035839 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

mass.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 311035839 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

temperature.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the effective temperature of TIC 311035839 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: HAT-P-3B is a star of 3,300 K, bound to HAT-P-3 1,321 AU away.
text.introduction: HAT-P-3B shares its motion through space with HAT-P-3, 1,321 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: HAT-P-3B's orbit around HAT-P-3 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 1510191594552968960 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 40,000 of its distance per century
